author: AffixIO
description: AffixIO verification infrastructure over MCP. Agents call the live AffixIO contract (circuits, prove, verify, attestation) instead of guessing paths. OAuth via AffixIO Hub; no key pasted into config.
name: AffixIO

prompts.description: List the catalogue of available AffixIO verification circuits.
prompts.name: list_circuits
prompts.title: List available circuits

resources.description: Current AffixIO OpenAPI schema: the HTTP source of truth behind the MCP tools.
resources.name: affix-openapi
resources.title: AffixIO OpenAPI schema

tools.description: Send an authenticated GET request to an AffixIO /v1 or /api endpoint. Takes path and an optional query object. Use it to list circuits (GET /v1/circuits), check spent status, fetch Merkle proofs and read service health. Account, key, OAuth and webhook administration paths are excluded.

query.description: Optional query parameters as a JSON object.

tools.name: affix_api_read
tools.title: AffixIO API read

tools.description: Send an authenticated POST, PATCH or DELETE to an AffixIO /v1 or /api endpoint. Takes method, path, optional query and a JSON body. Requires the mcp:write scope on the token. Use it to prove and verify circuits and request ML-DSA-65 attestations. A successful verify spends the proof digest and is not reversible.

query.description: Optional query parameters as a JSON object.

tools.title: AffixIO API write
